title: Microsoft Teams: granular channel notification controls
summary: The presets, default state and cloud-specific rollout windows match Microsoft's records. However, the page turns an absence of documented tenant controls into an unsupported assertion that policy cannot constrain the rollout. The Intune path also needs its app-selection steps, and rollout completion dates should remain expectations.
